chapter_seo_title: Void Heaven Cauldron Battle Begins – Man Brutal Beard’s Mutant Beast Changes Everything
chapter_meta_description: The battle for the Void Heaven Cauldron explodes as Man Brutal Beard reveals a mutated Three-Eyed Leopard that can turn magic treasures to stone, forcing every Nascent Soul elder to recalibrate their plans.
og_title: A Mutated Spirit Beast Turns the Tide in the Void Heaven Palace Showdown
og_description: Man Brutal Beard’s Three-Eyed Leopard unveils an Anomalous Transformation that shatters the righteous alliance’s numerical advantage in an instant.
twitter_title: The Void Heaven Cauldron Battle Begins – And It’s Already a Mess
twitter_description: Man Brutal Beard’s mutated leopard just turned an elder’s magic treasure into stone. The power balance just collapsed.

lore_anchors.definition: A catch-all term for the unique, unpredictable abilities of mutated spirit beasts; these abilities bypass normal magical rules and can turn objects to stone, nullify defenses, or other reality-bending effects.
Descendants of ancient spirit beasts that have evolved into new distinct lineages over time; extremely rare but not unique—multiple individuals of the same breed exist.
A one-in-ten-thousand spirit beast that underwent a random, unrepeatable mutation during advancement; each is a unique existence with a potentially game-breaking ability.
Man Brutal Beard’s spirit beast, formerly a fire-element attacker; now revealed to have mutated to possess a stone-transformation eye beam that turns magical tools and treasures into ordinary rock.
A wood-element control technique that produces countless fine green threads capable of binding even supernaturally strong corpse demons with seemingly effortless flexibility.
A giant turtle under Tianwuzi’s command that can release massive clouds of freezing mist; used in this chapter to counter the Confucian-robed elder’s Blue Thorn Birds.
A flock of cyan-feathered birds under the Confucian-robed elder’s command that can collectively fire a cohesive pillar of green flame.
A type of high-grade corpse demon refined by Extreme Yin Patriarch; each is powerful and difficult to replace, making their preservation a priority in battle.
The highest tier of combat power in the human realm; an existence whose every action is a statement of systemic class and whose casual displays of force can reshape battles.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Wan Tianming attack first if he thought he had the advantage?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He was provoked by Man Brutal Beard’s insult, but more importantly he believed his numerical superiority (Cold Flood Dragon + Spirit-Turning Turtle) would overwhelm the demonic side—until the mutation was revealed.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the Three-Eyed Leopard’s stone beam a one-time attack?
cultural_notes_faq.a: No—the narration treats it as a sustained ability of a mutated spirit beast, not a consumable technique; it can be fired repeatedly as long as the beast has energy, making it a persistent threat to any treasure-reliant cultivator.
